look.why: A deep nocturnal Sulawesi twilight indigo that highlights the enormous golden eyes and tiny acrobatic frame.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 0.35 m (body 9.5–14 cm plus 20–26 cm tufted tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Lowland tropical rainforests, secondary scrub, bamboo thickets and mangroves on Sulawesi and nearby islands in Indonesia.

diet.text: Grasshoppers, beetles, moths, cicadas, spiders, small lizards and frogs—the only 100% carnivorous primates.

facts.text: Each eyeball is as large as its entire brain; because its eyes cannot move in their sockets, it rotates its head nearly 180° like an owl.
Elongated ankle bones (tarsals) give tarsiers their name and launch them across 3-meter leaps between tree trunks.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis dataran rendah, hutan sekunder, rumpun bambu, dan bakau di Sulawesi dan pulau sekitarnya.
id.diet: Belalang, kumbang, ngengat, tonggeret, laba-laba, kadal kecil, dan katak—satu-satunya primata karnivora murni.
facts: Setiap bola matanya sama besar dengan seluruh otaknya; karena mata tidak bisa melirik, kepalanya dapat menoleh hampir 180° seperti burung hantu.
Tulang pergelangan kaki (tarsal) yang memanjang memberi nama tarsius dan melontarkannya sejauh 3 meter antarbatang pohon.
